site.name: ITO Intersection
site.survey: Survey of India / NCT code-plate counts at ITO (5 arms), weekend mid-day + weekday AM peak, plus ITDP Delhi junction inventories
site.summary: Five-leg at-grade crossing of the Ring Road (N-S, grade separated over the centre), Vikas Marg (E-W) and Yamuna Marg (SE), with an arterial off the old Minto Road. Six signal heads, short storage and a pedestrian-heavy all-red: the stress case for standstill (v = 0) detection and gridlock alerting.
